name: Dokument suchen -> tool_search_documents
task: Finde meinen Mietvertrag in den Dokumenten.
expected_behavior: The document assistant must start with tool_search_documents (search words like Mietvertrag). It must answer only from the tool result - if the tool reports ok:false (e.g. not_permitted or not_configured in the test substrate) it says briefly that the document search is not available right now and does NOT invent a document, date or link.
notes: paperless Phase 2: Kern-Golden des Assistenten (Katalog-Example). Im LLM-Lauf ist der Test-Absender der gepairte Owner -> erlaubt; ohne Paperless-Adresse antwortet das Werkzeug not_configured; geprueft wird die Werkzeug-Wahl + dass nichts erfunden wird.

name: Dokument per Nummer lesen -> tool_get_document
task: Lies mir das Dokument mit der Nummer 42 vor.
expected_behavior: The user names the document id - the assistant must call tool_get_document with document_id 42 directly (no search needed). It reports only what the tool returns and never invents the document text.
notes: paperless Phase 2 (Katalog-Example get_document). document_id ist ein String (contract_lint: *_id nie number).

name: Ausdrueckliche Frage an die Dokumenten-KI -> tool_ask_documents
task: Frag die Dokumenten-KI, welche Kündigungsfrist mein Handyvertrag hat.
expected_behavior: The user explicitly asks the document AI - the assistant must call tool_ask_documents with the question. It must present the answer with its source documents and must not add facts that are not in the tool result.
notes: paperless Phase 2 (Katalog-Example ask_documents). Instruktion: ausdrueckliche KI-Frage -> direkt ask_documents.

name: Buchungswunsch -> kein Werkzeug, Verweis auf Finanzen
task: Buche 50 Euro fuer Tanken von meinem Girokonto.
expected_behavior: The document assistant is read-only and cannot book. It must not call any tool and must say in one sentence that bookings are handled by the finance assistant.
notes: paperless Phase 2: read-only by construction (keine Schreib-Werkzeuge gebunden) + Abgrenzung aus der router_description.
